document_title: IT Infrastructure & Troubleshooting Guide: 50 Comprehensive Support Scenarios
author: IT Infrastructure & Security Operations Team

overview.purpose: Provide an exhaustive, standalone repository of 50 technical setup steps, error codes, and troubleshooting protocols for remote employees and IT support agents.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.item: Download My_Bio_Medical Secure Client (OpenVPN v3.2+) from internal portal.
Configure Windows 10/11 client with `.msi` package using admin privileges.
Install macOS package (`.pkg`) and authorize extension in System Settings.
Deploy Linux OpenVPN client via terminal (`sudo apt install openvpn`).
Input gateway address `vpn.mybiomed.internal` into client configuration.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Authentication Failed due to bad password or expired token.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Verify IDP credentials and re-sync Duo Mobile app.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Blocked UDP/TCP ports on home router or public hotspot.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Switch connection protocol from UDP 1194 to TCP 443.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Local DNS cache conflict with internal `.internal` domains.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Flush local DNS cache (`ipconfig /flushdns` or `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache`).

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Remote computer did not respond (ISP throttling or MTU size mismatch).
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Adjust client MTU setting down to 1350 or switch network provider.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Virtual network driver uninstalled or quarantined by third-party antivirus.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Reinstall virtual network adapter from IT portal downloads page.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Client device time out of sync with domain controller.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Enable automatic network time synchronization in OS settings.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Duo push notification fails to reach mobile device.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Use passcode generation mode within Duo app or switch to SMS backup.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Local printer inaccessible while corporate VPN is active.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Verify split-tunnel routing rules with IT network administrator.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: BGP route propagation delay or upstream ISP outage.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Test connection via secondary backup gateway `vpn-backup.mybiomed.internal`.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Automatic security timeout triggered after 60 minutes of inactivity.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Re-authenticate with credentials and Duo push to resume session.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: IP address flagged by geographical security firewall block.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Submit ticket to IT security to whitelist approved residential IP range.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Virtual adapter unable to obtain internal corporate IP address.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Restart VPN service daemon (`sudo systemctl restart openvpn` or Windows service manager).

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Malformed `.ovpn` configuration file syntax error upon import.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Re-download fresh profile configuration file from employee portal.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Packet inspection failure caused by third-party corporate proxy interception.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Import custom corporate root CA certificate into system trust store.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Sub-optimal routing node selected by automatic gateway balancer.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Manually select regional gateway server (e.g., `vpn-us-west.mybiomed.internal`).

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: macOS Security policy blocks virtual network driver extension execution.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Approve extension in System Settings > Privacy & Security and reboot Mac.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Missing `network-manager-openvpn` package during GUI setup.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Install missing packages via apt/dnf package manager.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Windows Defender Firewall blocking inbound/outbound tunnel traffic.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Add exception rule for OpenVPN client executable in Defender settings.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Active Directory account locked after multiple incorrect VPN login attempts.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Self-service password reset via `identity.mybiomed.internal`.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: ISP IPv6 traffic bypassing encrypted IPv4 VPN tunnel.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Temporarily disable IPv6 on local network adapter settings.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Client software version incompatible with legacy virtual adapter driver.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Run automated driver cleaner utility and reinstall client package.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Hardware YubiKey OTP code rejected by authentication server.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Resync hardware token clock via IT admin helpdesk portal.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Hotel or airport Wi-Fi captive portal interfering with tunnel handshake.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Open browser, complete hotel/airport Wi-Fi terms acceptance, then reconnect VPN.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Client crashes during heavy encrypted data transfer due to memory limits.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Close resource-intensive background applications and restart VPN process.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Windows registry keys for network adapters corrupted by failed update.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Run `netsh int ip reset` and `netsh winsock reset` in elevated command prompt.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Obsolete cryptographic cipher suite rejected by updated security server.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Update OpenVPN client to latest stable release (v3.2+).

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: TUN/TAP interface disabled by network configuration manager.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Enable adapter via Device Manager or network control panel.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Upstream corporate/school proxy blocking direct socket connection.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Configure HTTP proxy credentials inside client advanced connection settings.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: OAuth token or client secret expired during automated background refresh.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Re-enter primary domain credentials in client login prompt.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Client unable to write session logs to local AppData directory.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Run application installer with full local administrator permissions.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Local subnet IP range overlaps with corporate internal subnet range.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Disconnect from local home subnet router or update static route table.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Enterprise endpoint agent quarantines VPN executable file.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Submit false positive report to internal security team via ticketing portal.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: VPN drops connection immediately upon laptop entering sleep mode.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Enable persistent keep-alive setting (`ping 10` directive) in client config.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Kill-switch fails to engage when network cable is unplugged.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Enable strict kill-switch protection mode in client preferences.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: User logged into VPN from maximum allowed concurrent devices (Limit: 2).
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Log out active session from secondary personal device.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Attempting to install 32-bit client package on ARM64 or x64 architecture.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Download correct native architecture installer package.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Offline laptop unable to reach OCSP revocation server.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Connect temporarily to open internet to update certificate revocation cache.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Client repeatedly loops login prompt despite correct password.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Clear stored credentials cache via client settings menu.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: Duplicate MAC address assigned on local virtual subnet switch.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Regenerate virtual adapter hardware address via network manager CLI.

it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.symptom: High throughput data stream causes packet loss on UDP socket.
it_support_and_troubleshooting_guides.resolution: Increase UDP send/receive buffer size parameters in advanced settings.
